## PR class
Research Infrastructure / preregistered public qualification setup. Keep Draft.

## Problem and bounded purpose
PR #124's 12/12 conservation calibration judges supplied child proposals. It does not establish that a primary profile can produce faithful declarations from a root-only capsule.

This separate setup freezes a public synthetic generation test: 12 roots (8 eligible, 4 ineligible), 4 metamorphic pairs, root-only target delivery, independently checked semantics/spans, and 3 deliberately weak generators. There have been **zero target or semantic-reviewer executions**.

## Frozen authority
- Base/protected main: `c26fbd4bfc8ba5c2604a784af158594b59fcae37`.
- Preregistration first: `bc2142049dd43888823fb5a73fda7ab0c90fa964`.
- Current R1 source: `1c94cb82262d6346cf4aef35ff50d8d70c4aacb3`; tree `fb629ae75b9924ebfa5968f1862648a788f33639`.
- Initial source `7e5cc1cef78e63aa4f0bacbd636f9e30bae37a6f` is preserved and superseded by the formatting-only R1 setup; no model/evaluator exposure occurred.
- Current envelope: `0988ee8756ce595477695d0cd451fb8d82002e88`; tree `b1bab5b6d3ce2b10a19269f63db11ee6ec02db88`.
- CANDIDATE.R1.json is authoritative and seals 17 source/workflow/history blobs and raw hashes. Original CANDIDATE.json and SETUP-RECEIPT.PUBLIC.json remain unchanged as initial-source history.
- Source packet: `research/eb_root_only_generation_qualification_rc0_20261002/`.

The inherited rubric, wire schema and proposal controls are byte-identical to [#124 source](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/evidence-bundler/tree/af9cebf187cc5e1f96683bfa1366c6641ea0139c/research/eb_prospective_authoring_retrieval_rc2_20261002). [#124](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/evidence-bundler/pull/124) remains OPEN/Draft at `bc3d887f27991c215e251875b964f205e478df21`, `BLOCKED_BEFORE_POPULATION_AUTHORING`. Its gates and budgets are not replaced or consumed.

## Setup evidence
- Mechanical packaging validator PASS on local Python 3.11 and 3.14.4.
- 12 root-only capsules checked; 2 boundary mutations rejected.
- 12/8/4 counts and all 4 metamorphic pairs checked.
- All three inherited Git blobs reproduced exactly.
- Protected production diff against the starting base is empty.
- New-public-file credential/private-path/transcript scan: no matches.
- Final-head hosted Python 3.11/3.12 setup checks passed: [run 37068914051](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/evidence-bundler/actions/runs/37068914051), jobs `111043420199` / `111043419954`, with actual allocated runners and successful validation/protected-diff steps. Initial [run 37068553906](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/evidence-bundler/actions/runs/37068553906) remains preserved. CI is mechanical only.
- Ordinary final-head [CI 37068914066](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/evidence-bundler/actions/runs/37068914066) also passed; it is not semantic qualification.
- Full-base diff formatting check passes on R1.

These checks establish packaging and encoded boundaries, not operational isolation, evaluator validity or generation capability.

## Public execution contract
The local owner must first use the constrained fresh profile-writer bootstrap, freeze actual primary/evaluator prompts, then independently freeze adapter/runtime/destination/receipt custody and evaluator code. Cases/oracle are denied to the profile writer before that freeze. Each target receives exactly one root capsule, never proposed children or gold.

Two new semantic-evaluator calibrations must each pass the inherited 12-case proposal gate. Then: 12 fresh root-only target sessions, 3 deterministic weak generators (36 records), 2 fresh arm-blinded decisive reviews of the 48-row packet, one tally and custody verification. No repairs, rerolls, replacement roles, adjudication or extra cases. First failures and actual exposures stay in the record.

Support requires 12/12 valid/status-correct target records; faithful two-obligation generation on all 8 eligible roots; correct abstention on all 4 ineligible roots; exact reviewer/oracle agreement; metamorphic conservation; and meaningful semantic failure of at least two weak generators, including the conjunction splitter. Subject origins are reported separately; unexercised inheritance remains unqualified. See the immutable PREREGISTRATION.md for the controlling protocol.

## Failures and deviations
DEVIATIONS.PUBLIC.json preserves the first sandbox DNS push failure and the first full-base formatting-check failure (one terminal blank line in the initial preregistration). The R1 successor removes only that blank line and visibly rebinds its packaging hash; protocol text, cases/oracle, controls, validator and workflow are otherwise unchanged. Original candidate and receipt bytes remain preserved. No profile/adapter/evaluator had been frozen or scientifically executed, and no semantic output was exposed.

## Production impact and non-claims
Only the new research subtree and research-only workflow are added. No prior record, production source/config/runner/version, contract, CAL, Decision or production ClaimGate change. No merge, release or promotion.

Profiles, adapter, runtime/destination, evaluator and operational custody remain UNBOUND. Actual authorability is UNKNOWN. Public fixtures are not a held-out naturalistic benchmark. A later public pass does not authorize private transmission, private population construction or PR #124 execution.

## Status and next authorized step
`SETUP_FROZEN / EXECUTION_NOT_RUN`.

Build/freeze and execute only this separately budgeted public qualification under its launch packet. Stop BLOCKED, INCONCLUSIVE, FALSIFIED or CONTAMINATED when the frozen rule applies. Publish the bounded result here. Private roots, corpus opening, retrieval and passage reviewers remain outside this authorization.
